description_en: Queries the throttling rules that are in effect
description_zh: 调用GetRunningSqlConcurrencyControlRules接口，获取正在执行的限流规则
name: GetRunningSqlConcurrencyControlRules

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

You must specify this parameter only if your database instance is an ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL instance or a PolarDB for MySQL cluster
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。
仅支持RDS MySQL和 PolarDB MySQL版实例
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The page number. The value must be a positive integer. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码，取值大于0且不超过Integer数据类型的最大值，默认值为1
parameters.name: page_no

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. The value must be a positive integer. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 每页最大记录数，取值大于0且不超过Integer数据类型的最大值，默认值为10
parameters.name: page_size

Data.description_en: The detailed information, including the error codes and the number of entries that are returned
Data.description_zh: 详细信息列表，包括信息总数、错误码等

ConcurrencyControlTime.description_en:
The duration within which the SQL throttling rule takes effect. Unit: seconds.

The throttling rule takes effect only within this duration
ConcurrencyControlTime.description_zh:
SQL限流的生效时长，单位为秒。
限流规则仅在生效时间内开启

ItemId.description_en: The ID of the throttling rule that is applied to the instance

KeywordsHash.description_en: The hash value of the SQL keywords. The hash value is calculated based on the SQL keywords that are contained in the SQL statements to which the throttling rule is applied
KeywordsHash.description_zh: 哈希值，根据输入的限流关键词计算出来的值

MaxConcurrency.description_en:
The maximum number of concurrent SQL statements. The value is a positive integer.

If the number of concurrent SQL statements that contain the specified keywords reaches this upper limit, the throttling rule is triggered
MaxConcurrency.description_zh:
SQL最大并发数，取值为大于或等于1的整数。
当包含关键词的SQL达到最大并发数时会触发限流策略

SqlKeywords.description_en:
The keywords contained in the SQL statements to which the throttling rule was applied.

SQL keywords are separated by tildes (\~). If the number of concurrent SQL statements that contain all the specified SQL keywords reaches the specified upper limit, the throttling rule is triggered
SqlKeywords.description_zh:
需要限流的SQL关键词。
多个关键词间用波浪线（~）分隔，SQL语句中需要同时包含这些关键词才会触发限流规则

SqlType.description_en:
The type of the SQL statements. Valid values:

SELECT

UPDATE

DELETE
SqlType.description_zh:
选择SQL的类型。取值：
SELECT
UPDATE
DELETE

StartTime.description_en: The time when the throttling rule started to take effect. The value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC
StartTime.description_zh: 获取正在执行的限流规则的开始时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位为毫秒

Status.description_en: The status of the throttling rule. The value of Open indicates that the throttling rule is in effect
Status.description_zh: 限流规则的生效状态，取值为Open：限流规则正在生效中

Total.description_en: The total number of entries returned

Message.description_en:
The returned message.

If the request was successful, Successful is returned. If the request failed, an error message such as an error code is returned
Message.description_zh:
请求返回消息。
请求成功时该参数返回Successful，请求失败时会返回请求异常信息（如错误码等）

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true

false
Success.description_zh:
请求是否执行成功：

true：执行成功
false：执行失败
